Name: Terran Industries
Description:
Climate risk is financial risk. We make it measurable.

Terran Industries is an enterprise-grade climate risk intelligence firm. We quantify climate exposure in financial terms — giving boards, CFOs, and leadership teams the data to protect enterprise value, reduce regulatory exposure, and make risk-adjusted decisions.

At our core is the Lex Framework — a science-based, CFO-ready architecture built on 7 strategic Pillars and 42 measurable Elements. Lex integrates every major global ESG and climate disclosure standard into a single system. Every Element is tracked through impact, financial, and operational metrics.

Our Capabilities:
 Climate & ESG risk diagnostics across environmental, economic, supply chain, reputational, operational, and regulatory risk domains
 ESG reporting & regulatory alignment — CSRD, TCFD, ISSB, ASRS, GRI, SASB, SEC climate disclosure rules, UN SDGs
 Carbon accounting & emissions management — Scope 1, 2, 3 analysis, science-based targets, reduction strategies
 Supply chain sustainability & third-party risk assessment — supplier ESG due diligence, Scope 3 liability mapping
 Climate adaptation & resilience planning — scenario modelling, physical and transition risk quantification
 Double materiality assessments — impact and financial materiality
 Outsourced CSO services — fractional Chief Sustainability Officer capability
 ESG data management & audit-ready reporting
 Greenwashing prevention — scientifically verified, auditable evidence

We are scientists, analysts, and risk specialists — not consultants in disguise. Our work is grounded in current science, tested methodology, and commercial realities.
Every dollar unaccounted for in climate exposure is a future liability. We turn that blind spot into a strategic advantage.

Name: Envirolapse
Description:
At Envirolapse, we’re a team of climate-driven technologists, adventurers, and problem-solvers working to make environmental monitoring smarter, more scalable, and more impactful.

We are a deep-tech climate company building real-time environmental monitoring systems for extreme and remote environments — combining AI, ruggedised hardware, and smart data pipelines to improve safety, scientific research, and sustainability outcomes.

Our mission is to deliver real-time, visual environmental insights using advanced camera systems, weather stations, and edge-based data tools—empowering researchers, industries, and frontline decision-makers to act quickly, safely, and responsibly in the face of a rapidly changing planet.

From the glaciers of Antarctica to alpine corridors in Aotearoa and the Canadian Rockies, we design and deploy remote-access systems that monitor avalanche activity, track glacial retreat, support search and rescue, and reduce emissions by replacing the need for high-risk, high-emission field visits.

We believe data should be more than numbers — it should tell stories, save lives, and drive meaningful, real-world impact. That belief powers our vision: to lead a new era of climate visibility and resilience through bold innovation, deep field experience, and a commitment to protecting the world’s wildest places.

Name: getting to zero
Description:
Getting to zero provides consultancy services to finance, operations and sustainability teams across sectors.  We support with advisory, design and implementation services in three ways. First, we help your data & strategy to understand technology options and set a strong foundation to manage and integrate ESG data with financial and operational data. Second, we support CFOs to report & disclose by embedding ESG into internal reporting and mandatory disclosures. Finally, we help you plan & reduce by connecting drivers into your integrated business planning processes and your supply chain to identify growth scenarios that reduce carbon pollution. 

Around half of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions are produced by larger SMEs. However, only 10% are currently measuring their emissions. A lack of skills and knowledge make planning and reporting on climate-related metrics a challenge. We are here to solve this problem. 

We implement best-in-class emission disclosure solutions for organisations to report on sustainability. With Data & Analytics expertise, we connect your carbon emissions and ESG data with Financial, People, & Operational data to help you embed sustainability across your firm and build strategies on your journey to decarbonise profitably.  

Mandatory reporting is now an urgent priority for Boards. From ESRS in Europe, the SEC in the US, to the International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB part of IFRS) in countries like Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan and Malaysia. New mandatory disclosures have arrived - and they are impacting many mid-sized firms for the first time. 

You can be compliant with new legislation while strengthening your business reputation with customers and stakeholders as a leader in your industry. Run your business more efficiently and profitably while making a positive impact. 

Accelerate your zero-emission transition with Getting to Zero.

We support agriculture, agribusiness, insurance, mining, logistics, energy, finance, infrastructure and government with intelligence designed to improve planning confidence.

We don't just forecast the weather. We help the world prepare for it.

Name: Prodegee.com

Institutional investors manage $90 trillion in assets, yet less than 0.5% reaches green infrastructure — leaving a $2 trillion annual climate finance gap.

Each is addressed by six targeted solutions, 60 in total.

This problem-solution architecture is implemented through 16 constitutionally protected core features spanning responsible infrastructure, ontological intelligence, sovereign operations, and climate finance transformation — embedded architecturally, not bolted on. Principled constraints become competitive advantages — not despite being ethical, but because of it. This is what ethical AI means to us.

Data sovereignty builds trust. Privacy enables participation. Projects access institutional capital without surrendering autonomy.

Name: BoltScope
Description:
BoltScope is the carbon-truth engine built for modern supply chains.

Regulators, investors, and customers now demand auditable Scope 3 data — but today’s collection process is messy, manual, and painfully redundant. BoltScope replaces endless spreadsheets and one-off surveys with a secure, blockchain-verified hub where suppliers upload ESG data once and instantly share it with every buyer who needs it.

What we do
Collect once, share everywhere. Standardised self-service forms guide suppliers — even small businesses — through emissions and ESG reporting in minutes.

Verify at the source. Cryptographic proof and smart validation rules lock every submission onto an immutable ledger, creating assurance-grade “Climate Receipts.”

Connect the network. A marketplace model lets corporates search, compare, and license supplier data — cutting reporting cycles from months to days and surfacing hotspots for decarbonisation.

Why it matters
Compliance, de-risked. ISSB, EU CSRD, SEC Climate, and ASIC RG 280: stay ahead of the fastest-moving regulations.

Investor-ready transparency. Demonstrate credible Scope 3 action and unlock sustainability-linked finance.

Supplier-friendly. One portal, zero licence fees for suppliers, and automated feedback that highlights reduction opportunities.

Where we are
BoltScope is pre-revenue and deep in customer discovery with global brands across apparel, logistics, and manufacturing. Early-access pilots launch Q4 2025 - join us to shape the future of verified ESG data.

Name: Nature Signal
Description:
Nature Signal is building the financial signal for nature risk.

More than $44 trillion of global economic value is moderately or highly dependent on nature, yet financial markets still lack a trusted, decision-ready system to measure and price ecosystem risk.

We translate complex environmental data across land, water, biodiversity, and supply chains into simple, decision-grade insights for companies, banks, insurers, and investors.

Our platform connects ecosystems, supply chains, and capital markets—enabling organisations to identify risk, improve resilience, and redirect capital toward measurable nature improvement outcomes.

Through our financial decision signals — Nature Risk, Nature Stable, and Nature Gain — companies and financial institutions can optimise portfolios, improve sourcing and underwriting decisions, and systematically shift capital toward lower-risk, more resilient assets.

As regulation, disclosure requirements, and market expectations accelerate globally, Nature Signal provides the infrastructure needed to embed nature into financial and operational decision-making.

We believe nature will become a core financial variable of the global economy—and that trusted, transparent signals will fundamentally reshape how capital is priced, allocated, and rewarded in the decades ahead.
